assessments.summary: The checker appears to encode the stated no-three-in-line, embedding-count, saturation, one-removal, two-removal, and corollary predicates correctly, but the bounded evidence does not establish that it was successfully run on the intended 152-point configuration. The configuration bytes are absent, objectiveAttestation is null, and results.json is only asserted output rather than a self-verifying certificate. Thus the claim is not disproved, but its coordinates, exactly eight embeddings, all 5777-cell saturation checks, removal census, and output agreement remain unverified.
scopeQualifications: Conditional on successful execution against the intended configuration bytes, the static audit found the checker substantially aligned with all declared predicates.
The arithmetic 77^2 - 152 = 5777 and the stated corollary from the removal bounds are correct.
No declared reference transactions exist, so no external mathematical dependency may be used.
evidenceIssues: The bytes of ../record-152-certificate/configuration.txt are not supplied, so the claimed 152-point set cannot be decoded or independently checked.
objectiveAttestation is null; there is no trusted evidence that rigidity.py ran successfully against the intended configuration and committed results.json.
The SHA-256 value in results.json cannot recover or certify the missing configuration bytes.
results.json does not itself contain enough independently checkable information to verify all 5777-cell computations.
The actual no-three-in-line property, symmetry and embedding count, saturation, one-removal robustness, two-removal enumeration, and computed-output agreement remain unresolved.
